name: SIH 26171 - On-Device Visual Perception Agent
description: Phase 1 scaffold: on-device browser agent shell. Captures the visible tab and runs local WebGPU object detection (Xenova/yolos-tiny via @huggingface/transformers) entirely on-device -- zero network calls at inference time. PII scanning (Phase 2a), redaction (Phase 2b), and DOM action execution (Phase 3) are not implemented yet; content.js is a stub for them.
